trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Checked release history** — v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback; on-call has been paged.

Recommendation: hold v2.3.1 until the regression is diagnosed — it should not be re-deployed without investigation.
